about_the_game:
Welcome to Stack & Sort Pals - Expansion Pack 1, a delightful and brain-teasing puzzle game where logic and strategy lead to victory! Your mission is simple yet challenging: sort and stack colorful blocks, each representing a cute animal, into perfectly organized columns. But beware—every move counts!

New in Expansion Pack 1:

🌟 A Fresh Theme – Discover a brand-new world filled with surprises!
🦊 New Animal Friends – Meet adorable new pals to stack and sort!
🎨 Enhanced Visuals – Enjoy fresh colors and designs for a more immersive experience!

How to Play:

🐾 Drag & Drop – Move blocks around and stack them by color.
🧠 Plan Your Moves – Think ahead to avoid getting stuck and clear the board efficiently.
🌈 Solve the Puzzle – Organize every column so each one contains a single color.

Key Features:

✔ Hundreds of Puzzles – From easy warm-ups to mind-bending challenges!
✔ Adorable Blocky Friends – Meet charming animals with unique personalities.
✔ Relaxing Yet Addictive – Simple to pick up but hard to master!
✔ No Time Limits – Enjoy stress-free puzzle-solving at your own pace.
✔ Colorful & Engaging Design – A visually appealing world full of fun and charm.

Think you have what it takes to master the art of sorting? Test your skills and explore the exciting new expansion in Stack & Sort Pals - Expansion Pack 1! 🏆🐶🐱
